# Spanda Works

> Spanda Works LLC is a software company in Charleston, South Carolina, founded on June 17, 2026. We build AI products.

## Products

- [Tīrtha](https://tirtha.ai): One API for the models you need, and a router for coding agents that checks each tool call against your schema.
- [RecompOS](https://recompos.app): A consumer GLP-1 body-recomposition app. Tracks the medication schedules, doses and symptoms you log, with structured progress signals and an AI coach that explains your logged data. It does not give medical advice.
